summary: US national security officials convened at Camp David to discuss next steps against Iran and Houthis, coinciding with a Houthi attack on Saudi Aramco facilities in Riyadh and renewed Saudi airstrikes on Sanaa. The US Treasury Secretary declared Iran will have zero oil shipments at sea this week for the first time in history, while Israel struck the Gaza apartment of Hamas leader Al-Amoudi. Regional tensions escalate across multiple fronts.
key_points: Trump's national security team met at Camp David Friday night to discuss next steps against Iran and Houthis, recalling a similar meeting preceding previous escalation. (Source: @lelotsenzura/94467)
Houthi attack caused heavy smoke at Saudi Aramco oil facilities in Riyadh, prompting cessation of air navigation over Riyadh airspace. (Source: @asafroz/53990)
Saudi airstrikes targeted Amran governorate and capital Sanaa, with footage circulating of strikes in Sanaa. (Source: @naya_foriraq/92458)

US Treasury Secretary Bessent stated Iran will have no oil on water this week for first time since exports began, and US facilitated 1.1 billion barrels through Strait of Hormuz. (Source: @VahidOnline/78610)
IDF struck the Gaza apartment of Al-Amoudi, Sinwar's reported replacement, with casualties reported but Al-Amoudi's fate unconfirmed. (Source: @yediotnews25/135724)
Israeli Minister Ben-Gvir declared entire West Bank belongs to Israel and threatened to topple the Palestinian Authority, contradicting Oslo Accords. (Source: @presstv/209361)
Eight IDF Armored Brigade soldiers lightly injured in operational traffic accident in southern Lebanon. (Source: @lelotsenzura/94466)
Two Iranians charged in UK for plotting attack on Manchester Jewish community with homemade bomb, allegedly directed from inside Iran. (Source: @mamlekate/104756)

points: Russian Security Council Deputy Medvedev stated Russian companies' investment in Iran's oil sector covers approximately 7% of Iran's total oil production, with plans for new nuclear power plants and the Rasht-Astara railway project; Iran-Russia trade increased 20% last year. (Source: @SharghDaily/187319)

Netanyahu claimed the Islamic Republic will fall and a 'day of freedom' for Iranians is coming, asserting the regime is 'very weak' due to US siege under Trump weakening the IRGC, and that Israel with US prevented Iran from obtaining nuclear weapons while Iran develops long-range missiles. (Source: @VahidOnline/78607)

Iranian President acknowledged enemy plan to cut vital arteries to pressure the Iranian people, admitting increased economic pressure but claiming government efforts prevented enemy from achieving goals in the economic war. (Source: @naya_foriraq/92451)
China has stopped sending satellite images to Iran, reportedly telling Iran to first resolve its issues with the United States. (Source: @kianmeli1/92883)

US Treasury Secretary Bessent announced Iran will have no oil shipments at sea this week for the first time since exports began, eliminating revenue; US also facilitated passage of 1.1 billion barrels of oil through the Strait of Hormuz and is isolating Iran 'unprecedentedly'. (Source: @VahidOnline/78610)

Trump's core national security team met at Camp David for a multi-hour undisclosed session on next steps in the war with Iran; the last such meeting preceded the outbreak of hostilities seven months ago. (Source: @mamlekate/104759)

Leaked IRGC instructor training package contains 2,521 files covering weapons, sniping, ambushes, guerrilla warfare, night combat, explosives, psychological operations, urban unrest control including 'shooting by skilled marksmen' and classifying post-election crowds as 'abnormal'. (Source: @shin_persian/10706)

Netanyahu in Daily Mail interview vowed Islamic Republic will fall, criticized Western governments for focusing criticism on Israel while ignoring Iranian threats, and claimed Israel-US cooperation blocked Iranian nuclear weapons. (Source: @VahidOnline/78607)

Far-right Minister Ben-Gvir declared all three administrative zones of the occupied West Bank are Israeli territory, contradicting Oslo Accords, and threatened to topple the Palestinian Authority. (Source: @presstv/209361)

IDF conducted an assassination attempt in Gaza, blowing up the apartment of Al-Amoudi, described as Sinwar's replacement; reports indicate casualties but no official confirmation on Al-Amoudi's fate. (Source: @yediotnews25/135724)

A grenade was thrown in Tel Aviv's Tzahala neighborhood; police opened a criminal investigation with no injuries reported. (Source: @N12chat/228255)

key_developments: Trump's national security cabinet convened at Camp David Friday night to discuss next military steps against Iran and Houthis, mirroring a pre-war meeting seven months ago. (Source: @lelotsenzura/94467)
Houthi attack struck Saudi Aramco oil facilities in Riyadh, causing heavy smoke and halting air traffic over the Saudi capital. (Source: @asafroz/53990)
Saudi Arabia renewed airstrikes on Houthi positions in Amran governorate and Sanaa, with video evidence emerging from the capital. (Source: @naya_foriraq/92458)

US Treasury Secretary Bessent confirmed Iran will have zero oil tankers at sea this week for the first time in history, while US facilitated 1.1 billion barrels through Hormuz. (Source: @VahidOnline/78610)
IDF assassinated or attempted to assassinate Al-Amoudi, Sinwar's reported successor, via airstrike on his Gaza apartment; casualties reported, fate unconfirmed. (Source: @yediotnews25/135724)
Israeli Minister Ben-Gvir declared full Israeli sovereignty over the entire West Bank and threatened to topple the Palestinian Authority. (Source: @presstv/209361)
Two Iranians charged in London for plotting a homemade bomb attack on Manchester Jewish community, allegedly directed by an individual inside Iran. (Source: @mamlekate/104756)
sections.threat_assessment: The convergence of a high-level US Camp David meeting, Houthi strikes on Saudi energy infrastructure, and Israel's decapitation strike in Gaza indicates a coordinated escalation axis. Iran's unprecedented oil export halt suggests the maritime blockade is achieving strategic effect, potentially forcing Iranian retaliation. The leaked IRGC urban warfare doctrine reveals preparation for internal suppression amid external pressure. Ben-Gvir's annexation rhetoric risks igniting West Bank unrest while IDF operates in Gaza and Lebanon. The Portugal base legal review signals NATO ally involvement may expand operational reach against Iran.
sections.regional_response: Saudi Arabia responds to Houthi attacks with renewed airstrikes on Sanaa and Amran, while Yemeni government forces threaten Houthi destruction. Russia reaffirms strategic partnership with Iran, rejecting pressure to abandon ties, and advances nuclear energy cooperation. China's suspension of satellite intelligence to Iran signals diplomatic distancing under US pressure. UAE's designation of the FlyDubai incident as terrorism indicates hardening Gulf stance against Iranian-linked operations. The Egypt-Eritrea-Sudan-Somalia summit reflects Horn of Africa realignment amid Red Sea tensions.
sections.intelligence_notes: The Camp David meeting's secrecy and historical precedent suggest imminent kinetic action decisions. Iran's zero oil exports week marks a sanctions enforcement milestone; monitor for IRGC naval response in Hormuz. The IRGC training leak provides rare insight into internal security priorities: urban unrest control, psychological operations, and guerrilla tactics. Al-Amoudi strike demonstrates Israeli intelligence penetration of Hamas leadership succession. Ben-Gvir's statements may reflect government policy testing. The Manchester plot indicates Iranian external operations persist despite domestic pressure. UAVs over Urmia suggest continued Israeli or US surveillance of northwestern Iran.
